applies_why: The judge text grounds an UNDERDETERMINED result in the Acts 2:30 text not naming whose body is the channel.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: 'does not state a link or its contrary' and 'ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED': one reading forbids treating a verse's silence as support for UNDERDETERMINED; the other would allow silence about whose body is the channel to leave the point open.
why: The judge treats the absence of an explicit naming of the channel in the Acts 2:30 text as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which K-S2 forbids.
